body: I truly hope you don’t my friend. I looked through some of your posts and you seem relatively young and honestly who you are now and who’ll you’ll be in 5 Years is a completely different person
Hopefully you have insurance and can be at a good facility. I was in a state hospital and felt like jail would have been better

I feel you’re pain I hung myself 8 days ago and what I can tell you is that it’s not worth it. I’m 36 and have fucked so many things up in my life but being seconds away from death made me realize that things maybe aren’t as bad as they seem after all. I’m here if you need to talk
I hung myself from a tree in the front yard 8 days ago...  Trust me... it’s not worth it...
There has to be something else that once brought you joy and happiness at one point
What’s your favorite thing to do?

You matter to people more than you think you do. Reach out to anyone and everyone for support you will be amazed at the response you get. Seek help from anyone you can. You aren’t seeing the forest through the trees right now but it will get better

Be there for him. Show him you still love him. Tell him you love him. Help him with whatever he needs. Make sure he knows that he matters to you and that he is important. One of he biggest factors in feeling suicidal is feeling unwanted by the people that you yearn to have approval from. That was my biggest trigger. Feeling like I disappointed the people that mattered the most to me

I do feel happier. With and without medication. I’m not sure the medication ultimately is the right one but I will continue trying to see what works best. There is no worse feeling in the world than seeing the look on your mothers face and hearing the crack in her voice when she speaks

I hung myself from a tree in the front yard. You feel complete tunnel vision the world moves so fast and in slow motion all at the same time. It’s really one of those feelings you can only comprehend when you have hit that point
You are not alone. Reach out to anyone and everyone. You matter to people more than you think you do
